note: These inventory items are ETHANOL TINCTURES: alcohol extracts of the raw resin/botanical, NOT steam-distilled EOs and NOT resinoids. The odorant is the ethanol-soluble resin fraction at the declared charge, so this file records (a) the botanical identity and (b) which constituents ethanol actually dissolves. Do NOT model the tincture as the raw resin or as the distillate EO - the composition differs. The stock's active fraction stays ASSAY_STATUS=HOLD until the dry-residue measurement in prepared_stocks.json.

benzoin_siam.alcohol_soluble: benzoic acid + resin esters (coniferyl benzoate, benzyl benzoate, cinnamyl benzoate) and free balsamic acids; the gum is largely insoluble in ethanol
benzoin_siam.perfumery_role: balsamic fixative; slows dispersion of other volatiles
benzoin_siam.contrast_with_eo: There is no true benzoin EO; the commercial odorant is the resinoid/tincture, so EO data does not apply.

benzoin_sumatra.alcohol_soluble: benzoic acid + cinnamic acid + resin esters

myrrh.alcohol_soluble: resin acids and furanosesquiterpenes (e.g. furanoeudesma-1,3-diene, curzerene); the gum fraction is water-soluble and does NOT extract into the ethanol tincture
myrrh.contrast_with_eo: The distilled EO is sesquiterpenoid and volatile; the tincture carries the heavier alcohol-soluble resin acids that the EO leaves behind.

olibanum.botanical: Boswellia spp. (B. sacra = Oman; B. frereana = Somalia; B. papyrifera = Ethiopia; B. serrata = India)
olibanum.alcohol_soluble: boswellic acids (triterpenoids) and resin acids, plus incensole/incensole acetate and a minor monoterpene fraction; these resin acids are exactly what the ethanol tincture extracts
olibanum.odour: terpenic, incense, peppery, spicy, old wood, woody, pine, resinous, green
olibanum.contrast_with_eo: The steam-distilled EO is ~75% monoterpenes (alpha-pinene, limonene, alpha-thujene, beta-pinene) and contains NO boswellic acids. The tincture is boswellic-acid/resin-rich and much heavier than the EO - EO constituents are a poor stand-in.

storax.botanical: Liquidambar orientalis (Asia Minor); Liquidambar styraciflua (US/Mexico/C. America)
storax.alcohol_soluble: storesin (alcoholic resin, ~33-50% of purified balsam) with cinnamyl cinnamate, ethyl cinnamate, benzyl cinnamate, phenylpropyl cinnamate, cinnamic acid; traces vanillin and styrene. All of these are ethanol-extractable
storax.contrast_with_eo: Distinguished from benzoin (also historically called 'storax'); styrene is a tincture/oxidation marker, not a distilled-EO component.
